observation_scope: column names and file names only: on 2026-10-02, with the owner's approval, the header line of MnM2/dataset_information.csv and the member names of the archive listing were read before the tag (logged in <local path>); no subject row, image, mask or label was read. Everything else is checked by extract-mms2 after the tag: the CSV contract fails closed (HUMAN_GATE, exit 8) on a column, subject code or DISEASE value outside the declaration; vendor, scanner and field strength are data-driven
mount_note: extract-mms2 writes the source area on the host (Windows tar.exe); inside the container ./data/raw is a nested read-only bind, so the area is read-only there; extracted files also carry the read-only attribute

archive.name: MnM2.rar
archive.extractor_note: bsdtar (libarchive) reads RAR; GNU tar cannot; tar -xO fails on RAR directory entries, so files are extracted with -xf -C <dest> -T <list>; only the release CSV is read with -xO (one file member) into memory; there is no file fallback: a failed or empty read fails closed (HUMAN_GATE, exit 8) and nothing is written
archive.cloud_copy: CSE-1: off-site storage keeps an unopened storage-only copy; extraction always reads the hash-verified D: copy

release_files_expected.info_csv: MnM2/dataset_information.csv (selected by its unique file name)
release_files_expected.member_rule: each expected file name occurs exactly once among the archive file entries, else HUMAN_GATE; the observed folder template MnM2/dataset/<ID>/ and the 3,964 listing entries are compared and recorded in the receipt, never blocking

extraction.byte_check: every extracted file size equals the archive listing; the extracted file set equals the list

case_id_key.expected: zero-padded subject code 001-360 (split hash and file names)
case_id_key.bound: file-name prefix <ID>; CSV SUBJECT_CODE (integer or zero-padded)
case_id_key.note: downstream case_id = patient_id = MMS2_<ID>, sample_id MMS2:MMS2_<ID> (owner decision C)

pathology_key.expected: NOR | LV | HCM | ARR | FALL | CIA | TRI | DRV or a declared synonym (configs/cohorts.yaml mms2.info_csv); the release spells DRV as RV (distinct values read before the tag, decision D-2)
pathology_key.bound: CSV DISEASE (column observed before the tag)
pathology_key.note: crosswalk configs/cohorts.yaml mms2.crosswalk; evaluation-only; any other value fails closed (HUMAN_GATE)

vendor_key.bound: CSV VENDOR (column observed before the tag); normalized to Siemens, GE or Philips when it names exactly one
vendor_key.note: descriptive stratum vendor; never fails closed

scanner_field_keys.note: descriptive strata scanner and field_strength; never fail closed

geometry.bound: mask header pixdim and affine column norms
